scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "bun run --cwd frontend dev" "cd backend && .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001"
scripts.dev:host: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "bun run --cwd frontend dev -- --host" "cd backend && .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001 --host 0.0.0.0"
